metadata.title: OpenTUI native help clean successor with verifier-owned PTY

work.objective: Independently make the Bun/OpenTUI /help dialog valid and height-aware at 80x24 so its footer remains visible, Esc closes it and Ctrl+C exits; leave real PTY proof exclusively to the independent verifier.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths for every read, search, edit and command.
Only modify the four allowlisted help/dialog files; do not modify Ink, renderer dispatch, dependencies, lockfiles, Marshal state, commit, push, publish, use network access or start subagents.

Do not read, search, list, compare, import or copy any R1/R2 worktree, patch, transcript, WorkerResult, ReviewPacket or Marshal run artifact; implement independently from the frozen base branch requirements.
Use only child composition supported by the real @opentui/react reconciler; TextNodeRenderable must receive supported span/text children.
Keep the footer visible at 80x24 by bounding or scrolling the shortcut content independently of the footer; do not solve this by hiding required footer text.

Worker development checks are limited to OpenTUI vitest, CLI typecheck/build and git diff --check; do not launch Bun, expect, PTY diagnostics or background processes because the independent verifier owns native proof.
Keep this a native help correctness fix; do not perform broader visual parity redesign.
If an operation is denied, do not retry that path; use an allowed relative-path equivalent or report blocked.
context: The current base can crash /help with TextNodeRenderable child-type errors and can push the footer below an 80x24 viewport when shortcut rows consume the dialog height.
Previous help runs are blocked and must not be integrated or inspected. This successor starts independently from origin/feat/opentui-migrate.
The independent PTY verifier waits for ready, sends /help, requires the exact footer marker For more help:, sends Esc, then Ctrl+C and requires EOF without critical errors.
Preserve slash gateway, command processing, mouse behavior, prompt behavior and current layout outside the help dialog.
